categories.name: 15. Storytelling & Communication Expressions
emotions: Quiet, as if sharing a secret

neutral.title: Neutral / Storyteller
neutral.tip: 🎯 **Vocal Coach Tip**: Sit tall with relaxed shoulders. Keep your pitch in a comfortable mid-range with a calm, steady cadence.
neutral.hindi: पुराने जमाने की बात है, जब घने जंगलों के बीच एक शांत नदी बहती थी। वहां के लोग कहते थे कि उस नदी में एक जादू है।
neutral.english: Deep within the ancient mountains, where the mist never seemed to clear, an old traveler began his long journey.
